definitions.explanation: One of the four divisions of the year (spring, summer, autumn, winter).

examples.japanese: {好|す}きな{季節|きせつ}は{何|なん}ですか。
{日本|にほん}には{四|よっ}つの{季節|きせつ}があります。
この{季節|きせつ}は{果物|くだもの}がおいしくて、{毎日|まいにち}{食|た}べています。
examples.english: Fruit is delicious this season, and I eat it every day.

examples.japanese: この{季節|きせつ}は{花|はな}がきれいで、{天気|てんき}もいいから、{外|そと}で{食|た}べるのが{好|す}きです。
examples.english: The flowers are beautiful this season and the weather is nice, so I like eating outside.

notes:
{季節|きせつ} refers to the seasons of the year.

The four seasons:
- {春|はる}: spring
- {夏|なつ}: summer
- {秋|あき}: autumn/fall
- {冬|ふゆ}: winter

Common expressions:
- {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}: changing of the seasons
- {季節|きせつ}{外|はず}れ: out of season
- {四季|しき}: the four seasons (more literary)

Note: Japan's distinct four seasons are an important cultural concept, often referenced in literature, art, and daily conversation.
